summary: Iteration 3 backend test — Agentes (Nutricionista) + Consultório (Agente 2) + Área do Paciente (Agente 3) + patient signup + permissions. 23/23 new tests pass (1 PDF upload test skipped — reportlab not installed; .txt upload test covered the same extraction path). All endpoints listed in the review_request work as specified: agents are seeded, prompt_chars/prompt_max_chars=50000 returned correctly, role-based 401/403 enforced, patient signup creates role='patient' and httpOnly cookie, /auth/me now returns role correctly, consultorio + patient real AI chat (Claude Sonnet 4.5) returns reply<60s and persists history. Email is lower-cased on signup (intentional). The previous iter1/iter2 backend test files use the OLD admin credentials (admin@evonut.com/evonut123) which were replaced by admin@rogeriocosta.com.br/rogerio2025 in this iteration — those 21 setup errors are CREDENTIAL DRIFT, not real regressions, but main agent should update those test files.

minor.issue: Returns 400 'Já existe uma conta com este e-mail. Faça login.' when a duplicate signup is attempted with the SAME lead token — correct, but the error message recommends 'login', whereas the user is signing up again with a fresh lead/token. Consider 'E-mail já cadastrado em outra pré-consulta'.

title is passed as a Query string parameter (?title=…) while the body is multipart/form-data. Mixing query-string title with multipart upload is unusual; either accept title as a multipart Form field or document the query param in the OpenAPI schema.
documents are returned newest-first (created_at -1) but build_agent_system_prompt concatenates them oldest-first (created_at 1). Two opposing sort orders — minor UX inconsistency; pick one.
Entire file is read into memory (await file.read()) before the 15MB size check — a malicious upload of a 1GB file would exhaust RAM before the check fires. Use a streaming/spooled approach.

Patient context is built with up to 5 exams + meal plan content + anamnese + evaluation, then truncated to 18000 chars in ai_consultorio_chat. Truncation happens silently mid-JSON which may produce malformed context. Consider summarising/pruning instead of hard slice.

action_items: Update /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and /app/backend/tests/test_iter2.py to use admin@rogeriocosta.com.br/rogerio2025 (currently still use admin@evonut.com) — 21 tests blocked at login fixture.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1459 lines — has grown ~70% since iter2 (was 850). Splitting into routers/agents.py, routers/consultorio.py, routers/patient.py, services/agent_prompt.py is now urgent.

build_agent_system_prompt loads ALL agent documents from Mongo on every chat message. For a busy /patient/chat or /consultorio/chat this is wasteful — cache in memory with TTL or invalidate on PATCH/POST/DELETE document.
extract_text_from_upload checks extension/content-type only — same MIME-spoof risk as iter2 noted; consider python-magic for true sniffing.

AGENT_PROMPT_MAX_CHARS = 50000 char cap is character-based; Claude is token-based. 50k chars ≈ 12-15k tokens which is fine for Claude 4.5, but a single very-large doc could push past tokens limit if it contains many short lines (each line costs ~3 tokens). Worth migrating to tiktoken/anthropic token count.
consultorio_messages session_id = `${nutri_id}-${patient_id}` is deterministic per patient — fine, but history is loaded fully (50 msgs) every turn; consider sliding window in DB query.

patient_signup returns 400 for 'duplicate email' BEFORE checking that the lead has email — actually it checks email presence first (line 1311-1313). Good. But if a patient has signed up once and the lead is re-used, the second signup attempt with a different password is silently blocked — no way for a patient who forgot password to recover (no /password-reset endpoint).

set_auth_cookie uses SameSite=none + Secure — correct for cross-origin preview, but no CSRF token. /api/patient/chat and /api/agents/* are state-changing endpoints reachable from any origin with the cookie. Add CSRF or change to Authorization header for state-changing endpoints.

Lead creation /api/leads is still UNAUTHENTICATED and routes to the FIRST nutritionist (sort created_at:1) when no ?nutri= slug is provided — a public spam flood would fill mongodb. Add rate-limit or captcha.

Duplicate-signup test passed because the second signup tried a DIFFERENT lead token with the same email; the first signup test used the same email but in patient_signup_data fixture. Currently the duplicate path is the 'existing user with this email' branch (line 1314-1318). Good — confirmed working.
